- Attestation: FIPS 140-2/3 and HSM vendor attestation (Thales/Entrust or AWS CloudHSM).
- Rotation policy: quarterly rotation with ability to revoke and rewrap prefix cache without service downtime.
- Auditability: detailed key-use logs routed to customer SIEM; audit retention 7 years for regulatory reviews.
- Residency: Primary control plane in NA, but option to keep model state and logs within EU regions for EU business lines.
- SSO: SAML integration required, SCIM for user provisioning.

- 2-week sandbox to validate: 1) AWS KMS CMK integration + key rotation scenario, 2) Azure Key Vault HSM-backed key wrap/unwrap latencies, 3) end-to-end audit log forwarding to SIEM sample.
